duty: Mark content generated with generative AI, so its reliability can be checked against other sources.
Check generated content for factual accuracy and relevance before it is used.
Tell the people who receive content when it was created with generative AI.
Do not enter data classified restricted or higher into generative AI tools; limit their use to public data.
Restrict analysis by generative AI to public or open datasets, anonymise first, and keep a clear record of the analysis process.
Verify outputs, especially for official reports, and verify generated code before it is used or run.
Limit tool use to authorised staff, and keep records of how staff use the tool.
